quantitative_evaluation.regime_scoring_status: Descriptive manual label; no frozen minute-based classifier. Trend_down only partially supported by path, so not counted as a formal hit.
quantitative_evaluation.breadth_scoring_status: Diagnostic stock-count dominance only; no frozen breadth flat-band formula.

classification_notes.direction: ±5bp neutral band per metrics.py; both open and close down.
classification_notes.scenario: Close < -50bp is Bear, >+50bp Bull, otherwise Base.
classification_notes.brier: Mean of three squared probability errors; not single-day calibration evidence.
classification_notes.intraday: CNA timed reports support an early selloff and later recovery; OHLC alone does not establish minute order/VWAP. Daily high=open rules out the forecast +0.4% above-open path at any time.

market_view.note: Aligned overnight weakness identified negative direction and broad repricing, but the recovery counter-path mattered more than the dominant trend-down framing.

open_hypothesis.note: Down direction and stated -0.5% to -2% interval hit; forecast -120bp versus -56.59bp overestimated downside by 63.41bp.

intraday_hypothesis.note: Early follow-through below open occurred, then the index recovered much of the drawdown. Forecast +0.4% above open is contradicted by daily high=open; formal trend_down hit is withheld.

close_hypothesis.note: Down direction and Bear class hit, but -115bp forecast versus -61.38bp actual overestimated downside by 53.62bp.

breadth_hypothesis.note: Official stock-count breadth strongly negative: 163 up versus 849 down. Dated intraday coverage supports OTC underperformance, but exact closing OTC return was not retrieved.

bull_script.note: Index high remained below 46900 and previous close; no +50bp close.

base_script.note: Opening range and recovery path partially occurred, but close remained below the -50bp Base boundary. Financials did not provide broad closing support.

bear_script.note: Terminal Bear return and negative breadth occurred, but the low 46170 stayed above 46140 and the large recovery prevents treating all selloff clauses as confirmed.

key_driver_evaluation.driver: 台指期最後夜盤收46,140、相對參考價下跌1,144點（-2.42%）。
key_driver_evaluation.note: Night-futures weakness correctly indicated direction but exaggerated cash-gap and terminal magnitude.

key_driver_evaluation.driver: Nasdaq -2.15%、SOX -3.83%、TSM ADR -2.28%，海外科技與本地夜盤同向偏空。
key_driver_evaluation.note: Negative overseas technology mapping aligned with local electronics weakness and negative breadth; exact causal share not isolated.

key_driver_evaluation.driver: 週一08:50前Nasdaq期貨約+0.8%、S&P期貨約+0.5%，提供開低後修復反證。
key_driver_evaluation.note: Recovery counterevidence was useful directionally, but the later bounce cannot be causally assigned to NQ futures without an aligned series.
Prior positive breadth did not persist. Snapshot used news 696/293 universe rather than official stock-column 684/286; retained as an input-quality issue, not corrected in prediction.

key_driver_evaluation.driver: 美國10年期殖利率約5.0645%；Brent約108.06美元、早盤下跌1.6%，利率略緩但能源仍高。
key_driver_evaluation.note: Rates and energy are context; no independently measured same-day causal contribution.

key_driver_evaluation.driver: 台積電法說基本面正向，但10/16現貨收2,420且ADR續跌，價格接受度偏弱。
key_driver_evaluation.note: TSMC traded weak intraday but returned to flat at the close; forecast gave insufficient weight to its closing-auction support.

key_driver_evaluation.driver: 中國GDP、工業生產與零售資料預定10:00發布，實際值未納入。
key_driver_evaluation.note: Unreleased 10:00 China data were excluded from the snapshot; no causal attribution to that release is made without evidence.

invalidation_condition_evaluation.condition: 若現貨未開低，open_direction=down立即失效，但不得回寫本快照。
若開低後30分鐘台積電收復2,420、指數站回前收且上漲家數超過60%，Bear/trend_down情境失效。
invalidation_condition_evaluation.note: Index never returned to previous close; full conjunction failed irrespective of the missing 30-minute breadth series.

invalidation_condition_evaluation.condition: 若跌破46,140且OTC、AI權值、金融與非電子同步轉弱，selloff尾端風險高於點估。
invalidation_condition_evaluation.note: Reported low 46170 remained above 46140; no confirmed break of that reference.

invalidation_condition_evaluation.condition: 10:00中國數據、08:50後消息及09:00後現貨行情只能用於覆盤。
invalidation_condition_evaluation.note: Post-cutoff observations were used only in evaluation; original snapshot unchanged.

invalidation_condition_evaluation.condition: 本檔不得宣稱為TEJ、ARIMA或TimesFM OHLC模型預測。
invalidation_condition_evaluation.note: Legacy forecast not represented as a TEJ/ARIMA/TimesFM OHLC prediction.

error_attribution.data: Official MI_INDEX was retrieved successfully. OHLC endpoint first timed out then returned an explicit security block; no further attempts, using dated CNA OHLC instead. Minute VWAP, intraday breadth path and official OTC closing return unavailable.
error_attribution.inference: Correct negative daily sign did not imply persistent one-way trend; first selloff then 652.08-point recovery should be separated.
error_attribution.weight: Overnight risk-off over-weighted versus recovery/closing-auction support; financial relative resilience did not hold at the close (-0.94% versus TAIEX -0.61%).
error_attribution.magnitude: Opening downside overestimated 63.41bp; terminal downside overestimated 53.62bp.
error_attribution.regime: Trend_down framing partly correct early but incomplete for a session ending only 22.56 points below open; no formal regime accuracy awarded.

actual_driver_attribution.claim: Technology pressure and broad risk reduction were visible.
actual_driver_attribution.evidence: Official 849 decliners versus 163 advancers; midcap100 -1.48%, smallcap300 -1.54%, ex-financial/electronics -1.77%.
actual_driver_attribution.causal_status: Observed cross-sectional evidence; not an exact causal decomposition.

actual_driver_attribution.claim: A later recovery, including TSMC closing-auction support, limited the index loss.
actual_driver_attribution.evidence: CNA dated report identifies late buying and TSMC returning to flat; low 46170 to close 46822.08 recovered 652.08 points.
actual_driver_attribution.causal_status: Observed path plus reported mechanism; exact index-point contribution unavailable.

actual_driver_attribution.claim: Defensive rotation did not uniformly protect non-technology sectors.
actual_driver_attribution.evidence: Financial -0.94%, plastics -2.09%, shipping -1.89%, oil/gas -4.95%; communication network +0.28% and retail +1.06% were exceptions.

source_conflicts.resolution: Use official MI_INDEX stock column; news population is incompletely specified.
Store separately; different coverage, not the same metric.
Use CNA dedicated opening report and daily summary O=46844.64. Headlines quoting >800-point 'opening' drops refer to later early trading, not the first index print.
MI_INDEX verified close. Failed/security-blocked OHLC endpoint was not used as evidence; CNA supplied O/H/L.

proposed_model_changes.proposal: Separate cash-auction gap from first-30-minute drawdown and closing-auction recovery, especially when overseas risk-off meets positive morning futures counterevidence.
Treat financial defense as a separately tested sector hypothesis; do not equate relative intraday resilience with closing outperformance.
Freeze breadth universe to official stock column and retain news-universe values separately; never revise a frozen prediction to fix its input.
Enforce 08:30 cutoff/08:40 persistence for new OHLC cohort and freeze minute-regime scoring before formal aggregate use.

model_change_gate.reason: Retain proposals for prospective/walk-forward testing; late legacy sample does not establish a validated new-model improvement.

limitations: Legacy output misses current cutoff and persistence contract despite pre-cash-open publication.
No eight-target TAIEX/TX OHLC forecast exists in this snapshot; no new-model OHLC metrics inferred.
No formal minute-based regime scoring or exact closing OTC return.
Single-day Brier does not measure probability calibration across days.
China-data and central-bank-news causal effects not assigned without aligned evidence.
